sentences.l2: Long ago, people in the old Roman city needed water.
sentences.l1: 很久以前,古罗马城里的人需要水。

sentences.l2: They lived far from the river.
They made a smart plan to bring water to their homes.
sentences.l1: 他们制定了一个聪明的计划,把水引到自己家里。

sentences.l2: Workers built long lines of stone.
sentences.l1: 工人们修建了一长排石头结构。

sentences.l2: This big engineering work helped move water from far away.
sentences.l1: 这项宏大的工程帮助把水从很远的地方运过来。

sentences.l2: The water went through deep holes in the hills.
sentences.l1: 水穿过山丘中很深的孔洞。

sentences.l2: It also crossed high stone bridges.
Water moved inside these paths every day.
sentences.l1: 水每天都在这些通道里流动。

sentences.l2: It went down slowly because the ground tilted.
sentences.l1: 因为地面是倾斜的,水缓缓向下流。

sentences.l2: The natural shape of the land pushed the water forward.
sentences.l1: 土地的自然形状推动水向前流。

sentences.l2: This great infrastructure changed daily life.
sentences.l1: 这项伟大的基础设施改变了日常生活。

sentences.l2: Clean water came right to the town.
sentences.l1: 干净的水直接来到了城镇。

sentences.l2: People used it to drink, cook, and wash.
sentences.l1: 人们用它来喝、做饭和洗涤。

sentences.l2: The smart design kept the city alive and well.
sentences.l1: 这个聪明的设计让城市保持生机和健康。
